title: Overkill for making iced coffee and a large machine; but better if making iced tea also
text:
Overkill for making iced coffee and a large machine; but better if making iced tea also. Besides this [[ASIN:B00CEHZZ4I Mr. Coffee BVMC-LV1 Mr. Coffee BVMC-LV1 Iced Cafe Iced Coffee Maker, 1, Black]], I also own three other Mr. Coffee speciality brewers and they are

[[ASIN:B005BG7MK4 Mr. Coffee BVMC-EL1 Cafe Latte]]
[[ASIN:B002FWMF8G Mr. Coffee BVMC-FM1 20-Ounce Frappe Maker]]
[[ASIN:B007K9OIMU Mr. Coffee BVMC-ECMP1000 Café Barista Espresso Maker]]

Unlike this machine, these three other brewers are excellent single or dual-purpose machines. However, I think this single purpose iced coffee maker is overkill because I can brew coffee in a regular coffeemaker and just add ice to get the same results.

Below are the PROS and CONs from my perspective:

PROS

- This brews nice ice coffee.

- A regular-sized pitcher is provided that I feel can be used as any other pitcher when not in use on this machine.

- The iced coffee is easy to make. Just fill the pitcher to the desired water level, pour it in the reservoir, insert the brew basket with a paper filter filled with the desired coffee grounds, swing the shower head over the basket, insert the pitcher filled with ice cubes to the desired level, plug in and turn the unit on.

- The unit comes with a recipe guide for making eight kinds of flavored iced coffees, one chai tea latte, and a recipe for cafe mocha popsicles.

CONS

- The unit is rather large. It is 12-1/2 inches tall; 10 inches wide, and about 12 inches in depth from front to back when the pitcher is stored in the sideways position or 14-1/2" in depth when in operating mode.

- The pitcher is not dishwasher safe. This is not a CON for me but may be for some people.

- Paper coffee filters (8-12 cup size) need to be purchased separately. It would have been nice had a small supply of about 5 filters come with the unit.

- When using decaf, the instructions say not to exceed 9 tablespoons of coffee and to set brew strength to the least amount (all the way to the left). I really do not understand why that is as it is not explained in the instruction booklet. To me that means less coffee can be made since when brewing 2 quarts, 12 level tablespoons of coffee grounds are suggested just don't use 12 if it's decaf coffee.

- The brew cylce takes a bit long (about 5 minutes) and water continues to drain into the pitcher even after the brewing sounds stop. Therefore, one must pay attention to ensure all the liquid has drained before removing the pitcher.

- As I removed the brewer basket with the spent grinds in it, the tiny bit of water that remained in the brewer basket resulted in coffee dripping down the unit as the basket is removed. This required extra cleanup.

Due to the CONS and the fact that I can make the same good iced coffee (minus the extra recipes, of course) using a regular brewer by combining ice with already brewed coffee, I consider this unit overkill. Nevetheless this is another specialty unit from Mr. Coffee that might satisfy a coffee fanatic who desires everything coffee related!

PS The links to my other Mr. Coffee machines is in the comments section of this review for those who are interested.

UPDATE July 18, 2013 - I've been using this machine to make iced tea and prefer to use it for that. So far I made about 10 quarts of iced tea over the past several weeks. As long as the tea is one that is brewed with boiling water, it actually makes iced tea quicker than I can make it myself. The reason is that it is only a one-step process with this machine. The regular way I would have to boil a pot of water, then steep the tea for 4 or 5 minutes and then pour the brew over ice. With this machine, I can use tea bags directly in the brew basket of the machine or a coffee filter for loose tea. For those who are both coffee and tea drinkers, this machine can serve two purposes.

product_metadata.title: Mr. Coffee BVMC-LV1 Iced Cafe Iced Coffee Maker, Black
description: Mr. Coffee Iced Cafe brews gourmet iced coffee in one simple touch. Simply add water to the reservoir, coffee grounds to the brew basket, ice to the pitcher and press brew. Brew up to 2 quarts of iced coffee for the perfect pick-me-up. The Mr. Coffee Iced Cafe comes with a 2 quart pitcher, adjustable brew strength, dishwasher safe brew basket and 10 delicious recipes. Brew Classic iced coffee, decadent Creme de Caramel iced coffee, delicious Chilling Chai Tea Latte or your own custom brew. Save up to 400 a year versus the coffeehouse.
